public_definitions: Task: assign next quarter's premium retail promotion budget to the brand with the highest current market_share.
Premium promotion rule: Select the brand with the highest current market_share.
Campaign scope: Next-quarter smartphone retail promotion.
Options: Select Apple, Select Huawei, Select Others.
uncertain: The chart's printed bar annotations (30%, 11%, 11%, 23%, 25%) do not match the visual bar heights; the task requires using the dashboard market_share values as the evidence source, but it is not specified whether to use the printed annotations or the visual bar heights.
If using printed annotations: Apple (30%) is highest. If using visual bar heights: Huawei is highest.
The option 'Select Others' corresponds to the 'Others' category in the chart, which is not a specific brand.
